// Exports the contents of a grid (using the selected order and filters) to an Excel file.
LoadWWPContext.Call(&WWPContext)

Do 'OpenDocument'

&CellRow = 1

Do 'LoadGridState'

Do 'WriteFilters'

Do 'WriteColumnTitles'

Do 'WriteData'

Do 'CloseDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */


Sub 'OpenDocument'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&Random = Random() * 10000
	&Filename = !"WWP_MailTemplateWWExport-" + &Random.ToString().Trim() + !".xlsx"

	&ExcelDocument.Open(&Filename)
	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Clear()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteFilters'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If not (&FilterFullText.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "WWP_FullTextFilterDescription")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&FilterFullText)
	EndIf
	If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Name")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateName.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Name")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateName)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Description")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Description")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Subject")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel)
	Else
		If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Subject")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject)
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Sender Address")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel, 1, 1000))
	Else
		If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress.IsEmpty())
			WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Sender Address")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress, 1, 1000))
		EndIf
	EndIf
	If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel.IsEmpty())
		WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Sender Name")
		&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel, 1, 1000))
	Else
		If not (&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName.IsEmpty())
			WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ExportWriteFilter(&ExcelDocument, true, &CellRow, &FirstColumn, "Sender Name")
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + 1).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName, 1, 1000))
		EndIf
	EndIf
	&CellRow += 2

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteColumnTitles'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&VisibleColumnCount = 0
	If &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWColumnsSelector') <> ''
		&ColumnsSelectorXML = &Session.Get(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWColumnsSelector')
		&ColumnsSelector.FromXml(&ColumnsSelectorXML)
	Else
		Do 'InitializeColumnsSelector'
	EndIf

	&ColumnsSelector.Columns.Sort(!'Order')
	For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
		If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = GetMessageText(iif(&ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName.IsEmpty(), &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName, &ColumnsSelector_Column.DisplayName))
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Bold = True
			&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Color = 11
			&VisibleColumnCount += 1
		EndIf
	EndFor

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'WriteData'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	For each WWP_MailTemplate
		order WWPMailTemplateDescription  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateDescription)  when &OrderedBy = 1 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateName  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateName)  when &OrderedBy = 2 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateSubject  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateSubject)  when &OrderedBy = 3 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress)  when &OrderedBy = 4 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		order WWPMailTemplateSenderName  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = False
		order (WWPMailTemplateSenderName)  when &OrderedBy = 5 AND &OrderedDsc = True
		
		using WWP_MailTemplateWWDS(&FilterFullText, &TFWWPMailTemplateName, &TFWWPMailTemplateName_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription, &TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject
					, &TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName, &TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel)

		// Write cell values
		&CellRow += 1
		
		Do 'BeforeWriteLine'
		&VisibleColumnCount = 0
		For &ColumnsSelector_Column in &ColumnsSelector.Columns
			If &ColumnsSelector_Column.IsVisible = True
				Do Case
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateName'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(WWPMailTemplateName)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateDescription'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(WWPMailTemplateDescription)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateSubject'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(WWPMailTemplateSubject)
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateBody'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(WWPMailTemplateBody, 1, 1000))
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(DB.WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress, 1, 1000))
					Case &ColumnsSelector_Column.ColumnName = !'WWPMailTemplateSenderName'
						&ExcelDocument.Cells(&CellRow, &FirstColumn + &VisibleColumnCount).Text = WWP_Export_SecureText(Substr(WWPMailTemplateSenderName, 1, 1000))
				EndCase
				&VisibleColumnCount += 1
			EndIf
		EndFor		
		
		Do 'AfterWriteLine'

	Endfor

	Do 'CheckStatus'
	&ExcelDocument.Close()

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	If (&ExcelDocument.ErrCode <> 0)

		&ErrorMessage = &ExcelDocument.ErrDescription
		&ExcelDocument.Close()
		Return
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

EndSub

Sub 'InitializeColumnsSelector'

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [Start] - Do not change */

	&ColumnsSelector = new WWPColumnsSelector()
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateName", '', !'Name', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateDescription", '', !'Description', True, '')
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateSubject", '', !'Subject', True, '')
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateBody", '', !'Body', True, '')
	WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateSenderAddress", '', !'Sender Address', True, '')
	WWPBaseObjects.WWP_ColumnsSelector_Add(&ColumnsSelector, !"WWPMailTemplateSenderName", '', !'Sender Name', True, '')
		
	&UserCustomValue = LoadColumnsSelectorState.Udp(!'WWPBaseObjects.Mail.WWP_MailTemplateWWColumnsSelector')
	If not(&UserCustomValue.IsEmpty())
		&ColumnsSelectorAux.FromXml(&UserCustomValue)
		WWP_ColumnSelector_UpdateColumns(&ColumnsSelectorAux, &ColumnsSelector)
	EndIf

	/* Generated by DVelop Work With Plus Pattern [End] - Do not change */

			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATEDESCRIPTION_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateDescription_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESUBJECT"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESUBJECT_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSubject_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERADDRESS"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERADDRESS_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderAddress_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERNAME"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
			Case &GridStateFilterValue.Name = !"TFWWPMAILTEMPLATESENDERNAME_SEL"
				&TFWWPMailTemplateSenderName_Sel.FromString(&GridStateFilterValue.Value)
		EndCase
	EndFor
